item.title: Hezbollah support endures in south Lebanon as ceasefire fails to stop war with Israel
item.description: Despite continuing Israeli attacks and occupation, many people in the south still believe the armed group is the only force capable of defending them.

item.title: His father had just been buried. Then West Bank settlers forced him to dig up the body
item.description: The UN human rights office condemns incident as "'appalling and emblematic of the dehumanisation of Palestinians" in the West Bank.

item.title: Hamas confirms top commander killed in Israeli air strike
item.description: Friday's strike is the latest launched by Israel on Gaza despite a ceasefire with Hamas.

item.title: Trump says 20-year nuclear programme suspension by Iran would be enough
item.description: The US president says Tehran has to show "real" commitment to removing nuclear fuel and stopping uranium enrichment.

item.title: US charges Iraqi with plots to target Jews in cities from London to LA
item.description: Mohammad Baqer Saad Dawood al-Saadi allegedly "directed and urged others to attack US and Israeli interests", in retaliation for the Iran war.

item.title: Lebanon says six killed in Israeli strike as US announces ceasefire extension
item.description: President Trump announced the truce last month, but Israel and Hezbollah have continued to exchange fire since then.

item.title: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon kill 22 people, health ministry says
item.description: Eight children are among those reported dead after a series of air strikes hit the south of Beirut.

item.title: Netanyahu says he 'secretly visited' UAE during war with Iran
item.description: The UAE denied reports of the "alleged visit" and insisted relations between the two countries were not based on "unofficial arrangements".

item.title: Fears of renewed Gaza war as Hamas disarmament talks stall
item.description: Israeli media reports suggest Israel is preparing to resume fighting because of the impasse in talks with Hamas.

item.title: 'Floating armoury' ship reportedly seized by Iran
item.description: A vessel said to be a “floating armoury” in the Gulf of Oman has been seized by Iranian military personnel, according to reports.
